title: First Aid (Wikibooks)
attribution: Text from the Wikibooks book "First Aid" (https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/First_Aid) by its contributors; each document links to the exact revision used, whose history lists the authors. Reformatted into sections. This pack is distributed under the same CC BY-SA 4.0 license.
description: Broad first aid coverage: assessment, CPR, choking, bleeding, shock, burns, injuries, medical emergencies, poisoning and wilderness first aid. Volunteer-written; some guidance (e.g. CPR rate and depth) follows older guidelines.
